findings: All-A 20-session net flow percentile contains useful medium-term market information in the development sample.
Boost-only overlays preserved four positive development years but did not reduce turnover and failed the 30bp complete-path stress.
Removing portfolio drawdown feedback made low-frequency holdings cost-path stable, but drawdown widened beyond the predeclared 20% envelope.
Cost-independent market or gross-equity drawdown references restored path stability but lost a positive development year and too much return.
rejected_engineering_changes: No flow threshold or market-drawdown rule was added to formal strategy code.
No portfolio drawdown reference change was retained.
No 2024-2025 or 2026 result was used to rescue a failed candidate.
next_step: Treat market-wide net flow as a registered explanatory feature; require a predeclared walk-forward market-risk model or genuinely lower-friction execution design before it can control formal exposure.
